messages.subject: Scheduled DMS maintenance - Saturday 19 July
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleague,

The document management system will be unavailable on Saturday 19 July from 07:00 to 11:00 BST for scheduled maintenance. Please save any open documents beforehand. Email is unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
